text: ДЕЦЕНТРАЛИЗОВАННЫЕ АВТОНОМНЫЕ ОРГАНИЗАЦИИ: НОВЫЙ ПУТЬ К ПРИНЯТИЮ РЕШЕНИЙ presents the following source proposition: The existing organizations bearing the status of DAO are analyzed and the main regulatory mechanisms in terms of contracts are described.
